skill.name: git-pr-workflows-onboard
skill.description: Creates role-specific technical onboarding plans, checklists, milestones, access preparation, learning paths, and feedback loops for new team members.
skill.summary: Build structured technical onboarding plans from pre-arrival preparation through 90-day reviews.
skill.author: sickn33

content.value_statement: Technical onboarding often lacks clear ownership, milestones, and role-specific guidance. This skill creates structured plans from pre-arrival preparation through 90-day progress reviews.
actual_capabilities: Creates onboarding plans from role, seniority, location, technical needs, and team context.
Organizes account, equipment, documentation, workspace, and meeting preparation before the start date.
Structures first-day orientation, development environment setup, and initial codebase learning.
Defines 30-day, 60-day, and 90-day milestones for technical contribution and team integration.
Adapts plans for software engineers, remote employees, and senior engineering leaders.
Provides checklists, buddy responsibilities, feedback loops, and onboarding success metrics.
limitations: Does not provision accounts, issue credentials, configure tools, or access company systems.
Requires accurate role, team, location, start date, and technical context.
Example milestones require adjustment for company policies, employment law, and team capacity.
The referenced detailed implementation playbook is not included in the package.

use_cases.title: Plan a Developer's First 90 Days
use_cases.description: Create role-specific setup, learning, contribution, and review milestones for a new software engineer.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Remote Onboarding
use_cases.description: Build a distributed schedule covering equipment, access, communication norms, buddy meetings, and recorded learning sessions.

use_cases.title: Accelerate a Senior Hire
use_cases.description: Prepare architecture reviews, stakeholder meetings, technical assessments, and ownership milestones for an experienced engineering leader.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Onboarding Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 30-day onboarding plan for a new [role] starting on [date]. Include preparation, Day 1, Week 1, and review milestones.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when basic role and start-date details are available.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Remote Engineer Onboarding
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a 30-60-90 day plan for a remote [level] engineer in [time zone]. Cover access, communication, codebase learning, buddy support, and measurable outcomes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a distributed engineering team.

prompt_templates.title: Design an Accelerated Leadership Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an accelerated onboarding plan for a new [senior role]. Include architecture immersion, stakeholder mapping, process assessment, early decisions, and 30-day deliverables.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for senior or lead engineering hires.

prompt_templates.title: Improve an Existing Program
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this onboarding program: [program details]. Identify coverage gaps, unclear ownership, unrealistic milestones, missing feedback loops, and useful success metrics. Produce a revised plan.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use to evaluate and improve an established onboarding process.

output_examples.input: Create a first-week plan for a mid-level backend engineer joining a hybrid payments team.
output_examples.output: A daily plan covering access, security training, architecture orientation, local setup, pair programming, the first small pull request, and manager check-ins.

output_examples.input: Prepare a 30-60-90 plan for a remote staff engineer.
output: First 30 days: map systems, stakeholders, risks, and team practices.
Days 31-60: lead a design review and propose prioritized improvements.
Days 61-90: own a technical initiative and establish measurable team outcomes.

output_examples.input: Assess our onboarding process using time-to-productivity and feedback measures.
output_examples.output: A measurement plan covering time to first commit, first deployment, milestone completion, knowledge retention, buddy feedback, and team integration.

best_practices: Provide role, seniority, location, start date, team structure, and technical requirements.
Review every milestone with the hiring manager, buddy, IT, security, and people operations.
Track progress through regular check-ins, measurable outcomes, and documented feedback.
anti_patterns: Do not reuse one plan without adapting it to the role, team, and location.
Do not place credentials, personal data, or confidential system details in prompts.
Do not treat checklist completion as proof of technical readiness or team integration.

faq.question: Can this skill create a complete 90-day plan?
faq.answer: Yes. It can organize preparation, first-day activities, weekly learning, contribution milestones, feedback, and 30-day, 60-day, and 90-day reviews.

faq.question: Can it support remote or hybrid employees?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers equipment delivery, time zones, asynchronous communication, virtual meetings, recorded sessions, and remote feedback.

faq.question: Does it configure accounts or development environments?
faq.answer: No. It creates planning guidance and checklists but cannot provision access, configure hardware, or execute setup commands.

faq.question: What information produces the best plan?
faq.answer: Provide the role, seniority, start date, location, team structure, technical stack, access needs, and expected early outcomes.

faq.question: Can it onboard senior engineering leaders?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes accelerated architecture immersion, stakeholder introductions, process assessment, technical planning, and early ownership milestones.

faq.question: How should sensitive access information be handled?
faq.answer: Keep credentials and personal data out of prompts. Use approved identity, secrets management, IT, and security processes for actual access.
